The 5-day average volume ratio is 0.83, indicating subdued trading, which lowers the reliability of current movements. Weekly RSI (39.0) and MACD histogram (-10.0089) also remain in weak territory, making it difficult for short-term bounces to lead to long-term trend reversals. Therefore, it is reasonable to wait and see for further indicator improvements in the current phase.
